Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim host As Workbook,src As Worksheet,dst As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,j As Object,k As Object,m As Object
Dim r As Long,c As Long,n As Long,before As String,after As String,changed As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set host=Application.ActiveWorkbook
Set src=host.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Data"
Set dst=host.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
dst.Name="Landing"
For r=1 To 6
For c=1 To 3
src.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r*3+c) Mod 7)+1
dst.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r+c) Mod 5)+1
src.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
dst.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
Next
Next
src.Range("A2").Value="apple"
src.Range("B3").ClearContents
src.Range("C4").Value="a*"
src.Range("A5").Value=CVErr(2042)
Set g=src.Range("E1:G6").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlLess,7)
g.Font.Italic=True
g.Interior.Color=vbGreen
Set f=src.Range("A1:C6").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=A1>0")
Set h=src.Range("B2:C4").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=B2<8")
h.Font.Italic=True
h.StopIfTrue=False
h.Priority=1
f.Priority=9
g.Priority=6
f.Font.Bold=True
f.Interior.Color=vbRed
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
f.NumberFormat="0.00 ""source"""
f.StopIfTrue=False
src.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
dst.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
src.Activate
before=Snapshot()
src.Range("B2:C4").Copy Destination:=src.Range("F3:G5")
Application.CutCopyMode=False
after=Snapshot()
f.Font.Bold=False
changed=Snapshot()
Probe="before=[" & before & "];after=[" & after & "];held=[" & Held(f) & "];mutated=[" & changed & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Application.CutCopyMode=False
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";before=[" & before & "];state=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)

P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then

End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"

Function Probe() As String
Dim host As Workbook,src As Worksheet,dst As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,j As Object,k As Object,m As Object
Dim r As Long,c As Long,n As Long,before As String,after As String,changed As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set host=Application.ActiveWorkbook
Set src=host.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Data"
Set dst=host.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
dst.Name="Landing"
For r=1 To 6
For c=1 To 3
src.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r*3+c) Mod 7)+1
dst.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r+c) Mod 5)+1
src.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
dst.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
Next
Next
src.Range("A2").Value="apple"
src.Range("B3").ClearContents
src.Range("C4").Value="a*"
src.Range("A5").Value=CVErr(2042)
Set g=src.Range("E1:G6").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlLess,7)
g.Font.Italic=True
g.Interior.Color=vbGreen
Set f=src.Range("A1:C6").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=A1>0")
Set h=src.Range("B2:C5").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=9,String:="a*",TextOperator:=0)
h.Font.Italic=True
h.StopIfTrue=False
Set j=Application.Union(src.Range("A2:A5"),src.Range("C1:C4")).FormatConditions.AddTop10
j.Rank=2
j.Interior.Color=vbYellow
h.Priority=5
j.Priority=2
f.Priority=8
g.Priority=12
f.Font.Bold=True
f.Interior.Color=vbRed
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
f.NumberFormat="0.00 ""source"""
f.StopIfTrue=False
src.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
dst.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
src.Activate
before=Snapshot()
src.Range("B2:C4").Copy Destination:=src.Range("F3:G5")
Application.CutCopyMode=False
after=Snapshot()
f.Font.Bold=False
h.Font.Italic=False
j.Interior.Color=vbCyan
changed=Snapshot()
Probe="before=[" & before & "];after=[" & after & "];held=[" & Held(f) & "];mutated=[" & changed & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Application.CutCopyMode=False
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";before=[" & before & "];state=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim host As Workbook,src As Worksheet,dst As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,j As Object,k As Object,m As Object
Dim r As Long,c As Long,n As Long,before As String,after As String,changed As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set host=Application.ActiveWorkbook
Set src=host.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Data"
Set dst=host.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
dst.Name="Landing"
For r=1 To 6
For c=1 To 3
src.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r*3+c) Mod 7)+1
dst.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r+c) Mod 5)+1
src.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
dst.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
Next
Next
src.Range("A2").Value="apple"
src.Range("B3").ClearContents
src.Range("C4").Value="a*"
src.Range("A5").Value=CVErr(2042)
Set g=src.Range("E1:G6").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlLess,7)
g.Font.Italic=True
g.Interior.Color=vbGreen
Set f=src.Range("A1:C6").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=A1>0")
Set h=src.Range("B2:C5").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=9,String:="a*",TextOperator:=0)
h.Font.Italic=True
h.StopIfTrue=False
Set j=src.Range("A1:B4").FormatConditions.AddAboveAverage
j.Interior.Color=vbYellow
Set k=src.Range("F2:H4").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=F2>0")
k.Font.Bold=True
Set m=src.Range("J1:J4").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=J1>0")
m.Font.Italic=True
g.Priority=8
k.Priority=20
m.Priority=30
f.Font.Bold=True
f.Interior.Color=vbRed
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
f.NumberFormat="0.00 ""source"""
f.StopIfTrue=False
src.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
dst.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
src.Activate
before=Snapshot()
src.Range("A1:C3").Copy Destination:=src.Range("F2:H4")
Application.CutCopyMode=False
after=Snapshot()
f.Font.Bold=False
h.Font.Italic=False
j.Interior.Color=vbCyan
changed=Snapshot()
Probe="before=[" & before & "];after=[" & after & "];held=[" & Held(f) & "];mutated=[" & changed & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Application.CutCopyMode=False
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";before=[" & before & "];state=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim host As Workbook,src As Worksheet,dst As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,j As Object,k As Object,m As Object
Dim r As Long,c As Long,n As Long,before As String,after As String,changed As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set host=Application.ActiveWorkbook
Set src=host.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Data"
Set dst=host.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
dst.Name="Landing"
For r=1 To 6
For c=1 To 3
src.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r*3+c) Mod 7)+1
dst.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r+c) Mod 5)+1
src.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
dst.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
Next
Next
src.Range("A2").Value="apple"
src.Range("B3").ClearContents
src.Range("C4").Value="a*"
src.Range("A5").Value=CVErr(2042)
Set g=src.Range("E1:G6").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlLess,7)
g.Font.Italic=True
g.Interior.Color=vbGreen
Set f=src.Range("A1:C6").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=A1>0")
Set h=src.Range("A1:B4").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=10)
h.Font.Italic=True
Set j=Application.Union(src.Range("A1:A4"),src.Range("C1:C4")).FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
j.DupeUnique=xlDuplicate
j.Interior.Color=vbYellow
Set k=dst.Range("E1:H6").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=E1>0")
k.Font.Italic=True
k.Priority=17
Set m=dst.Range("J1:J4").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=J1>0")
m.Priority=23
f.Font.Bold=True
f.Interior.Color=vbRed
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
f.NumberFormat="0.00 ""source"""
f.StopIfTrue=False
src.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
dst.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
src.Activate
before=Snapshot()
src.Range("A1:C3").Copy Destination:=dst.Range("F2:H4")
Application.CutCopyMode=False
after=Snapshot()
f.Font.Bold=False
h.Font.Italic=False
j.Interior.Color=vbCyan
changed=Snapshot()
Probe="before=[" & before & "];after=[" & after & "];held=[" & Held(f) & "];mutated=[" & changed & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Application.CutCopyMode=False
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";before=[" & before & "];state=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim host As Workbook,src As Worksheet,dst As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,j As Object,k As Object,m As Object
Dim r As Long,c As Long,n As Long,before As String,after As String,changed As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set host=Application.ActiveWorkbook
Set src=host.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Data"
Set dst=host.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
dst.Name="Landing"
For r=1 To 6
For c=1 To 3
src.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r*3+c) Mod 7)+1
dst.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r+c) Mod 5)+1
src.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
dst.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
Next
Next
src.Range("A2").Value="apple"
src.Range("B3").ClearContents
src.Range("C4").Value="a*"
src.Range("A5").Value=CVErr(2042)
Set g=src.Range("E1:G6").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlLess,7)
g.Font.Italic=True
g.Interior.Color=vbGreen
Set f=src.Range("A1:C6").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=A1>0")
Set h=src.Range("A1:A6").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=9,String:="a",TextOperator:=2)
h.Font.Italic=True
Set j=src.Range("B1:B6").FormatConditions.AddTop10
j.Rank=2
j.Interior.Color=vbYellow
f.Font.Bold=True
f.Interior.Color=vbRed
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
f.NumberFormat="0.00 ""source"""
f.StopIfTrue=False
src.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
dst.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
src.Activate
before=Snapshot()
src.Range("A2:B4").Copy
src.Range("F2:G4").PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteFormats,SkipBlanks:=True
Application.CutCopyMode=False
after=Snapshot()
f.Font.Bold=False
h.Font.Italic=False
j.Interior.Color=vbCyan
changed=Snapshot()
Probe="before=[" & before & "];after=[" & after & "];held=[" & Held(f) & "];mutated=[" & changed & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Application.CutCopyMode=False
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";before=[" & before & "];state=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim host As Workbook,src As Worksheet,dst As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,j As Object,k As Object,m As Object
Dim r As Long,c As Long,n As Long,before As String,after As String,changed As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set host=Application.ActiveWorkbook
Set src=host.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Data"
Set dst=host.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
dst.Name="Landing"
For r=1 To 6
For c=1 To 3
src.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r*3+c) Mod 7)+1
dst.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r+c) Mod 5)+1
src.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
dst.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
Next
Next
src.Range("A2").Value="apple"
src.Range("B3").ClearContents
src.Range("C4").Value="a*"
src.Range("A5").Value=CVErr(2042)
Set g=src.Range("E1:G6").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlLess,7)
g.Font.Italic=True
g.Interior.Color=vbGreen
Set f=src.Range("A1:C6").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=A1>0")
Set h=src.Range("B1:B6").FormatConditions.AddAboveAverage
h.Font.Italic=True
Set j=Application.Union(src.Range("A1:A4"),src.Range("C1:C4")).FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
j.DupeUnique=xlDuplicate
j.Interior.Color=vbYellow
src.Range("C2").Formula="=A1+2"
f.Font.Bold=True
f.Interior.Color=vbRed
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
f.NumberFormat="0.00 ""source"""
f.StopIfTrue=False
src.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
dst.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
src.Activate
before=Snapshot()
src.Range("A1:C3").Copy
src.Range("F3:H5").PasteSpecial xlPasteAll
Application.CutCopyMode=False
after=Snapshot()
f.Font.Bold=False
h.Font.Italic=False
j.Interior.Color=vbCyan
changed=Snapshot()
Probe="before=[" & before & "];after=[" & after & "];held=[" & Held(f) & "];mutated=[" & changed & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Application.CutCopyMode=False
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";before=[" & before & "];state=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

probes.source:
Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim host As Workbook,src As Worksheet,dst As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,j As Object,k As Object,m As Object
Dim r As Long,c As Long,n As Long,before As String,after As String,changed As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set host=Application.ActiveWorkbook
Set src=host.Worksheets(1)
src.Name="Data"
Set dst=host.Worksheets.Add(After:=src)
dst.Name="Landing"
For r=1 To 6
For c=1 To 3
src.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r*3+c) Mod 7)+1
dst.Cells(r,c).Value2=((r+c) Mod 5)+1
src.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
dst.Cells(r,c+4).Value2=4
Next
Next
src.Range("A2").Value="apple"
src.Range("B3").ClearContents
src.Range("C4").Value="a*"
src.Range("A5").Value=CVErr(2042)
Set g=src.Range("E1:G6").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlLess,7)
g.Font.Italic=True
g.Interior.Color=vbGreen
Set f=src.Range("A1:C6").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=A1>0")
Set h=src.Range("B2:C4").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=B2<8")
h.Font.Italic=True
h.StopIfTrue=False
h.Priority=1
f.Priority=9
g.Priority=6
f.Font.Bold=True
f.Interior.Color=vbRed
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
f.NumberFormat="0.00 ""source"""
f.StopIfTrue=False
src.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
dst.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=20
src.Activate
before=Snapshot()
src.Range("B2:C4").Copy
src.Paste Destination:=src.Range("F3:G5")
Application.CutCopyMode=False
after=Snapshot()
f.Font.Bold=False
changed=Snapshot()
Probe="before=[" & before & "];after=[" & after & "];held=[" & Held(f) & "];mutated=[" & changed & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
On Error Resume Next
Application.CutCopyMode=False
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";before=[" & before & "];state=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function

Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
